title: Field
description: A continuous quantity over space and time: a grid on a frame, or a series with one value for the whole planet at each time. Its arrays live outside git. A derived field is declared, never stored.

refines.description: For a series: the series of the same quantity that this one is finer than, over part of its span. Where both have a value, the panel shows this one

oneOf.description: A series: one value for the whole planet at each time
Rows of a dataset at places, drawn over the globe for the times they hold

file.description: The dataset's file, where it has several

as.description: What the data is read as, where it is not elevation of each time: relief is today's ground on a fixed datum, held through the times the field covers, which a coastline reads at the sea level of each time

places.description: For borders: the dataset of places that goes with them

variables.description: For a climate read as months from NetCDF-4: the file's variables of temperature and precipitation, each by time, month, latitude and longitude, and of those dimensions

water.description: For relief: today's ocean and lakes, as areas. The sea of each time floods only what today's ocean reaches; the ocean is the largest of its areas, and any other is an inland sea, held as a lake

prop.description: A series of the world's own measurements: the property whose claims give its values, each at its record's date. `from` then names the work that frames them

sheet.description: For a workbook: the sheet the series is on

first_row.description: For a workbook: the first row of data

columns.description: For a series read from a table: the columns of its time, its value and the band around it; names in a text table, letters in a workbook

time_to.description: The other end of the interval each row covers: a row is plotted at its middle

time_unit.description: What the time column counts: Ma, ka or years before 1950, ka before 2000, or calendar years

band.description: What the lo–hi band is, e.g. the 5th–95th percentiles of an ensemble

scenarios.description: For grids with several readings of the same thing: the first is the default picture's, and an alternative may draw another

variable.description: The variable of the dataset's file that holds it

span.description: Where it differs in kind from the first: elsewhere the first is drawn

projection.description: After its youngest snapshot, the field holds that snapshot as a projection until `until`

from.description: The fields it is derived from. For an isoline: the field it is drawn on, and for a field on a fixed datum a series of sea level, relative to today's, that the isoline rises and falls with

params.description: The rule's parameters, or for a grid read by the build what it needs besides its data

source.description: Where the rule or those parameters come from

uncertainty.description: What a click says of how far to trust a value of it, where a grid has no error bars

spread.description: How its uncertainty is carried (docs/STRUCTURE.md section 3.2, core/samples.ts): unknown, a single value whose uncertainty nobody gave; band, a low and a high around each value; alternatives, readings each its own picture; ensemble, members, such as runs of a model; claims, each value the world's own claim, with that claim's uncertainty; tiers, how near the evidence is

kind.description: What kind of field it is (docs/STRUCTURE.md section 3.6): a continuous or a categorical raster, points, lines or areas over the globe, or a series

layer.description: How a field of points, lines or areas is drawn over the globe: data, read by one renderer (core/fieldlayers.ts)

toggle.description: A toolbar button that draws it; without one it is drawn whenever its time holds

where.description: Only rows whose columns have these values

crs.description: The coordinates the dataset's geometry is in, where not latitude and longitude

thin.description: How far a line or an outline may stray from the dataset's, in degrees

group.description: What a row belongs to, which tints it: a column, what the panel calls it, and where the group's own row gives its name

pick.description: Whether a click picks its rows; by default it does

describe.description: What the panel calls a row

key_label.description: What the panel calls a row's key, if it shows it

rows.description: For a dataset read as rows: the rows are claims (docs/STRUCTURE.md section 3.1). How a row's key is made from its columns, what kind of thing a row is, and which column gives which property

kind.description: What a row is, from the vocabulary of kinds

key.description: A template: {Column} for a column's value, {#} for the row's place in the file

claims.description: By property: the column it comes from, and how it is read

as.description: string, number, text (in English), year (a year as the dataset counts it, with no year 0), year-end (the same, holding to the end of the year), ma (millions of years ago), ma-range (an older and a younger age column, in Ma), point (latitude and longitude columns, measured on today's Earth)

none.description: Values that mean the dataset gives none

by_value.description: A number for every row, or set by a column's value
